1.caption: The complete date-specific populations and the restricted longitudinal population. Entries and exits are counted independently from cluster movement.

2.caption: Study workflow. A common preprocessing reference is carried forward, while the embedding and clusters are refitted independently at each date. The alignment stage compares sets of continuing members, rather than arbitrary numeric labels.

3.caption: Silhouettes for the UMAP study model and the historical t-SNE/hierarchical recipe applied to the same current eight-feature inputs. Darker bars evaluate the financial features; lighter bars evaluate the embedding. Both recipes use eight clusters.

4.caption: Aligned group membership for the 39 instruments observed at all three dates. Bold tickers change aligned group at least once. The per-date quality annotations refer to the full 41-instrument partition. APN, MNP, GLN and PAN are omitted only from this complete-history view. Vertical position is layout; colours identify aligned groups, not sectors.

5.caption: Continuing-member Jaccard similarities underlying cross-date matching. Similarity is computed on 40 continuing securities in each period; index entrants and exits do not create artificial peer-group switches. Positive-overlap assignments transfer labels, while zero-overlap groups receive new identifiers.

6.caption: June 2025 aligned-cluster median deviations. Values are in June 2025 MinMax units. Row labels give aligned cluster identifiers and instrument counts; missing identifiers reflect retired groups, not missing observations.

7.caption: December 2025 aligned-cluster median deviations. Values are in June 2025 MinMax units. Row labels give aligned cluster identifiers and instrument counts; missing identifiers reflect retired groups, not missing observations.

8.caption: June 2026 aligned-cluster median deviations. Values are in June 2025 MinMax units. Row labels give aligned cluster identifiers and instrument counts; missing identifiers reflect retired groups, not missing observations.

9.caption: Sensitivity to cluster count from two to twelve under the study representation. Eight clusters remain the historical reference choice. Inspect financial-space quality together with minimum group size and seed agreement; the plot does not establish a uniquely correct number of economic groups.
